opportunities.name: Look up AA flight status by flight number and date
opportunities.description: On the American Airlines homepage, open Flight status, switch to flight-number search, enter a flight number and a travel date, then run the search.
steps: Open the American Airlines homepage.
Click the 'Flight status' tab.
Click the 'Flight number' option under 'Search by'.
Click the 'Flight number' input and type the flight number.
Click the 'Date' dropdown and choose the travel date.
Click 'Search' and read the flight status results.

opportunities.name: Filter Amtrak deals by region
opportunities.description: From the Amtrak Deals & Promotions page, open the 'Display deals in' region dropdown and pick a region to narrow the deal cards.
steps: Click 'DEALS' in the Amtrak top navigation.
Click 'Deals & Promotions' in the Deals menu.
Click the 'Display deals in' region dropdown (showing 'All Regions').
Choose the target region from the list.
Read the filtered deal cards.

instances.values: region = third option in the dropdown list (same option as the second visit)
region = same third option in the dropdown list

opportunities.name: Apply a facet filter on a Target category page
opportunities.description: On a Target category results page, open a facet chip (Type, Price, Color, Material), set its value, and close the panel to narrow the product list.
steps: Click the facet chip (e.g. 'Type', 'Price', 'Color' or 'Material') above the results.
In the side panel, tick the desired option, or type a min and max into the price fields.
Click the panel's close (X) button.
Confirm the result count and product list have updated.
parameters: facet_value (checkbox option, or price min and max)

opportunities.name: Look up a travel booking by number and last name
opportunities.description: On a travel-company page, open the booking lookup, enter a reservation or ticket number and the traveller's last name, then submit to view the booking.
opportunities.site: amtrak.com (Find Trip modal) and aa.com (Your receipts page)
steps: Open the booking lookup (Amtrak: 'MY TRIP' then 'Find Trip'; AA: 'Receipts and Refunds' from the footer).
Click the reservation or ticket number field and type the number.
If the form has a 'Select' dropdown, open it and choose 'Last Name'.
Click the last name field and type the last name.
Click 'Find Trip' or 'Find your receipt'.
